text:
john_sales: heads-up — FinTrust (enterprise) opened a support case. They want an in-console per-tenant SLO + cost drilldown that links directly to trace detail for a given request. Billing surprises on their side. asking for prioritized backlog item.

maria_pm: thanks. context: high-revenue pilot customer, wants visibility per-route & per-tenant (p50/p95/p99, request count), plus cost-per-call and a clickable trace link to our tracing UI. compliance note: traces may contain PII, so they need controls.

ajay_eng: quick take — we already emit per-request token counts and per-token cost calc in pipeline, and we have traces with trace IDs. Missing piece is the join key surfaced in the console and persistent mapping in telemetry storage. For MVP we can: 1) expose per-tenant/per-route metric tiles, 2) show cost-per-request snapshot, 3) include a trace_link if trace_id available.

samir_infra: infra constraints — trace retention is 7d, sampling is 10% for high-volume routes. For reliable link we either increase sampling or persist trace index for customer-visible requests. Also need hashing/PII stripping and RBAC so tenant sees only their traces.

kelly_support: FinTrust timeline — wants something for their quarterly review in ~6 weeks. Sales says they're willing to fund an accelerated workstream but need an estimate.

maria_pm: proposed scope (MVP):
- Console: per-tenant per-route table (p50/p95/p99, rps, total tokens)
- Cost: attach USD cost-per-request using existing token-cost calc (no token-level breakdown)
- Trace link: clickable if trace_id present; show notice if trace not sampled
- Security: hash trace IDs, tenant-scoped link, audit log entry when trace viewed

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Customer can filter by tenant and route in console and see latency percentiles and cost for selected window
- Clicking "view trace" opens tracing UI for that request when trace exists; non-sampled requests show "trace not available"
- RBAC prevents cross-tenant access; audit log entry recorded
- Performance: loading the per-tenant table must be <1.5s for <5k tenants

ajay_eng: rough effort estimate: MVP ~2 devs × 4 weeks (1 infra, 1 frontend/backend split) + 1 week security review. If we need guaranteed trace links (increase sampling/persist) add another 2 weeks.

maria_pm: non-goals for MVP: full token-level cost breakdown in UI, long-term trace retention, cross-tenant billing analytics (future phase).

ops-bot: created task PROD-3421 for "FinTrust: per-tenant SLO + cost drilldown with trace link" assigned to @ajay_eng, priority P2.

john_sales: noted. please include pricing option for accelerated delivery in the ticket. FinTrust will likely pay for a 2-week fast lane.

ajay_eng: implementation sketch (snippet we can show design-wise):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_FT_1234",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "window": "2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-07T23:59Z",
  "p50_ms": "120",
  "p95_ms": "720",
  "p99_ms": "1200",
  "requests": "24,532",
  "cost_usd": "110.42",
  "trace_link": "https://tracing.redwood/c/abcd1234"  
}
```

maria_pm: next steps:
- @ajay_eng to confirm infra estimate and whether sampling change required (by EOD Tue)
- @samir_infra to validate retention/cost impact (by Wed)
- @kelly_support to confirm FinTrust willingness to fund fast lane and exact deadline (by Wed)
- PM to schedule design review and security sign-off once estimates are in

kelly_support: I'll ping FinTrust and confirm funding.

samir_infra: noted, will run a quick cost delta for increasing sampling and persisting index, will post numbers tomorrow.

maria_pm: thanks — if we can get estimates this week I'll slot PROD-3421 into next planning cadence. :thumbsup:

john_sales: thanks team.
